File Information
Collection: HustleHub+ API - Part 3 (DevSecOps, Monitoring and Finalisation)
Environment: HustleHub+ Local
Collection Description
End-to-end tests for HustleHub+: authentication, RBAC, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, admin, validation/sanitisation, Part 3 tax estimation, account lockout, server-side sign-out, audit logging, ledger integrity and rate limiting (including the Part 2 retry-time fix). Run with Newman from the api folder: npm run test:api The API uses a self-signed certificate, so run Newman with --insecure (already in the npm script) or turn off SSL verification in Postman settings. Requests must run in order: later requests use ids and tokens saved by earlier ones. Each run creates fresh users, so the collection can be run repeatedly. Rate-limit counters are kept in memory; restart the API if you run the collection several times inside 15 minutes.
